name: strip
expr: y = strip(s); ny = strlength(y); y1 = double(y(1)); c = strip({'  a  ','  b'}); nc = numel(c); n1 = strlength(c{1}); cc1 = double(c{1}(1)); cx = strip({'xxaxx','xb'}, 'both', 'x'); ncx1 = strlength(cx{1});
comment: Sig: S = strip(S[,side[,char]]). Trim both. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: added CELL-ARRAY support (was throwing 'Not a char array'); applies element-wise -> cell of char vectors, same shape: strip({'  a  ','  b'})={'a','b'}; strip(...,'both','x') strips the given char. Scalar string path preserves string type. FP uses lengths + char codes.
